name: web-performance-audit
description: Use this skill when conducting a performance audit of a page, PR, or app — distinct from building performantly (use the web-performance skill for that). Two modes: quick PR triage or full app audit. Triggers: "performance audit", "check Core Web Vitals", "is this fast enough?", preparing a performance report.
when: When conducting a performance audit of a page, PR, or app; preparing a performance report
do-not-use-when: Building or fixing a component for performance (use the web-performance skill for guidance)
A general code review with no performance scope
No running app or build to measure against
